DELETE /api/network/directory/entries/:u.note: The overlay row is keyed by owner_user_id = the caller in every statement, so a member reads, writes and deletes only their own note; another member reads null, and a support session is refused 403.

GET /api/network/directory/entries/:uid.note: Any signed-in member reads a directory entry only while it is published and not withdrawn; staged, suppressed, archived and withdrawn entries answer 404, and the projection carries no account link, private source cell or review item.

GET /api/network/directory/entries/:uid/.note: The overlay row is keyed by owner_user_id = the caller in every statement, so a member reads, writes and deletes only their own note; another member reads null, and a support session is refused 403.

PUT /api/network/directory/entries/:uid/.note: The overlay row is keyed by owner_user_id = the caller in every statement, so a member reads, writes and deletes only their own note; another member reads null, and a support session is refused 403.
